Billy Byrne, at six, was rushing the can for this noble band, and incidentally picking up his knowledge of life and the rudiments of his education. He gloried in the fact that he was personally acquainted with “Eddie” Welch, and that with his own ears he had heard “Eddie” tell the gang how he stuck up a guy on West Lake Street within fifty yards of the Twenty-eighth Precinct Police Station.

45507-the-pony-rider-boys-in-louisiana-o.title: The Pony Rider Boys In Louisiana Or Following The Game Trail
45507-the-pony-rider-boys-in-louisiana-o.creator: Frank Gee Patchin
45507-the-pony-rider-boys-in-louisiana-o.description: A book by Frank Gee Patchin. "Major Clowney, sah, at your service," answered the tall, gray-haired, distinguished-looking southerner who had greeted the Professor at the railway station in Jackson. Four clean-cut, clear-eyed young men, who had left the train with the Professor, stepped up at that juncture and were introduced to the southerner as Thaddeus Butler, Ned Rector, Stacy Brown and Walter Perkins, known as the Pony Rider Boys.

46004-neighbors-unknown.creator: Charles G. D. Roberts
46004-neighbors-unknown.description: A book by Charles G. D. Roberts. Suddenly a sharp noise, beginning in the dimness far to the left of the Little Hills, ran snapping past them and died off abruptly in the distance to the right. It was the ice, thickened under that terrific cold, breaking in order to readjust itself to the new pressure. There was a moment of strange muttering and grinding.

77804-the-man-who-married-the-moon-and-o.title: And Other Pueblo Indian Folk-Stories
77804-the-man-who-married-the-moon-and-o.creator: Unknown
77804-the-man-who-married-the-moon-and-o.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. I FANCY that if almost any of us were asked, “When did people begin to make fairy stories?” our first thought would be, “Why, of course, after mankind had become civilized, and had invented writing.” But in truth the making of myths, which is no more than a dignified name for “fairy stories,” dates back to the childhood of the human race.

arxiv-2102-04051.title: HumanACGAN: conditional generative adversarial network with human-based auxiliary classifier and its evaluation in phoneme perception
arxiv-2102-04051.description: Abstract We propose a conditional generative adversarial network (GAN) incorporating humans’ perceptual evaluations. A deep neural network (DNN)-based generator of a GAN can represent a real-data distribution accurately but can never represent a human-acceptable distribution, which are ranges of data in which humans accept the naturalness regardless of whether the data are real or not.

arxiv-2310-04782.title: Improving the Reliability of Large Language Models by Leveraging Uncertainty-Aware In-Context Learning
arxiv-2310-04782.creator: Yuchen Yang, Houqiang Li, Yanfeng Wang, Yu Wang ∗
arxiv-2310-04782.description: Abstract In recent years, large-scale language models (LLMs) have gained attention for their impressive text generation capabilities. However, these models often face the challenge of ”hallucination,” which undermines their reliability. In this study, we introduce an uncertainty-aware in-context learning framework to empower the model to enhance or reject its output in response to uncertainty.

arxiv-2412-08655.title: Analysis of ( 3 + 1 ) ​ D (3+1)D and ( 2 + 1 ) ​ D (2+1)D nonlinear ultrasonic waves using conformal invariance
arxiv-2412-08655.creator: Sadataka Furui, Serge Dos Santos
arxiv-2412-08655.description: Abstract Localization and classification of scattered nonlinear ultrasonic signatures in 2 dimensional complex damaged media using Time Reversal based Nonlinear Elastic Wave Spectroscopy (TR-NEWS) approach is extended to 3 dimensional complex damaged media. In (2+1)D, i.e. space 2 dimensional time 1 dimensional spacetime, we used quaternion bases for analyses, while in (3+1)D, we use biquaternion bases.

arxiv-2508-07126.title: Pref-GUIDE : Continual Policy Learning from Real-Time Human Feedback via Preference-Based Learning
arxiv-2508-07126.creator: Zhengran Ji zhengran.ji@duke.edu, Boyuan Chen boyuan.chen@duke.edu, Project Website: http://generalroboticslab.com/Pref-GUIDE
arxiv-2508-07126.description: Abstract Training reinforcement learning agents with human feedback is crucial when task objectives are difficult to specify through dense reward functions. While prior methods rely on offline trajectory comparisons to elicit human preferences, such data is unavailable in online learning scenarios where agents must adapt on the fly.

arxiv-2508-18386.title: Hydrostatic bubbles of compressible fluid in an incompressible fluid Thanks: J. Jang was supported by an NSF Grant (DMS #2306910) Thanks: I. Tice was supported by an NSF Grant (DMS #2508400)
arxiv-2508-18386.creator: Juhi Jang, Ian Tice
arxiv-2508-18386.description: Abstract . We study stationary configurations of compressible barotropic fluids lying inside an incompressible fluid and acted upon by a constant gravitational field. Without gravity, it is a simple matter to construct solutions consisting of perfectly spherical bubbles of compressible fluid, but with gravity the stratification of the compressible fluid’s density prevents the existence of solutions with such simple geometries.

arxiv-2602-21318.title: Theta-Relations Among Degree-Based Tree Indices
arxiv-2602-21318.creator: Duaa Abdullah
arxiv-2602-21318.description: Abstract Degree-based topological indices enable structural analysis of graphs, with key applications in chemical graph theory. This paper explores connections among three tree indices: Albertson, Sombor, and Sigma. The Sigma index tightly bounds the Sombor index via sharp two-sided inequalities, revealing their asymptotic equivalence up to constants.

pmc-10660247.title: A Web-Based Patient Empowerment to Medication Adherence Program for Patients With Rheumatoid Arthritis: Feasibility Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-10660247.creator: Siriwan Lim, Ponrathi Athilingam, Manjari Lahiri, Peter Pak Moon Cheung, Hong-Gu He, Violeta Lopez
pmc-10660247.description: BackgroundLiving with a chronic illness such as rheumatoid arthritis (RA) requires medications and therapies, as well as long-term follow-up with multidisciplinary clinical teams. Patient involvement in the shared decision-making process on medication regimens is an important element in promoting medication adherence.

pmc-10758658.title: Comparing the Efficacy of Povidone-Iodine Versus Normal Saline in Laparotomy Wound Irrigation to Prevent Surgical Site Infections: A Meta-Analysis
pmc-10758658.creator: Christie Swaminathan, Wei H Toh, Ahmed Mohamed, Hussameldin M Nour, Mirza Baig, Muhammad Sajid
pmc-10758658.description: Surgical site infections (SSIs) are a known complication of laparotomies and intra-abdominal surgical operations leading to remarkable consequences on mortality, morbidity, and expenses. The study aims to assess the efficiency of irrigating laparotomy incision sites with povidone-iodine (PVI) or normal saline (NS) in diminishing the rate of SSIs in patients undergoing gastrointestinal operations for varying indications.

pmc-10805244.title: Cometabolism of Chlorinated Volatile Organic Compounds and 1,4-Dioxane in Groundwater
pmc-10805244.creator: Catherine Clark, Lee K Rhea
pmc-10805244.description: This article provides an overview of the bioremediation of groundwater plumes containing admixtures of chlorinated volatile organic compounds (CVOCs) and 1,4-dioxane. The remediation of these plumes has historically focused on the reductive dechlorination of the CVOCs. Many of the remaining plumes are relatively large, and contaminant concentrations are diluted below the concentrations that can sustain reductive dechlorination.

pmc-11442961.title: Smoking Cessation and Utilization of Cessation Assistance in 13 low- and middle-income countries - changes between Two Survey Rounds of Global Adult Tobacco Surveys, 2009–2021
pmc-11442961.creator: Chandrashekhar T. Sreeramareddy, Lai Pei Kuan
pmc-11442961.description: IntroductionMonitoring changes in cessation behaviors and cessation assistance is critical for policymaking.MethodsWe analyzed two rounds (2009–2014 and 2015–2021) of Global Adult Tobacco Surveys in 13 countries. We estimated the quit ratio, quit attempt, and utilization of cessation assistance. The availability of cessation services was obtained from World Health Organization reports.

pmc-11475462.title: Food Preservation in the Industrial Revolution Epoch: Innovative High Pressure Processing (HPP, HPT) for the 21st-Century Sustainable Society
pmc-11475462.creator: Agata Angelika Sojecka, Aleksandra Drozd-Rzoska, Sylwester J Rzoska, Youngseung Lee
pmc-11475462.description: The paper presents the ‘progressive review’ for high pressure preservation/processing (HPP) (cold pasteurization) of foods and the next-generation high-pressure and high temperature (HPHT, HPT) food sterilization technologies. It recalls the basics of HPP and HPT, showing their key features and advantages.

pmc-11505167.title: Binning Metagenomic Contigs Using Contig Embedding and Decomposed Tetranucleotide Frequency
pmc-11505167.creator: Long Fu, Jiabin Shi, Baohua Huang, Edward L Braun, W Brad Barbazuk
pmc-11505167.description: Simple SummaryMetagenomic binning is a part of the metagenomic analysis process that can classify the genomes in complex microbial communities into possible source species. It is dedicated to restoring more complete genomes and is conducive to studying microbial community structure and function. Obtaining more effective feature representations of genome sequences to improve binning is still a major challenge.

pmc-11567127.title: Optimal placement of distributed generation to minimize power loss and improve voltage stability
pmc-11567127.creator: Samson Ademola Adegoke, Yanxia Sun, Adesola Sunday Adegoke, Damilola Ojeniyi
pmc-11567127.description: Voltage instability is a major problem facing power utility companies due to a lack of maintenance and financial support to maintain the existing power system networks (PSN). Lack of maintenance occurs when PS fails to replace the aging equipment and services and upgrades existing networks.

pmc-11725952.title: Unveiling intimacy: sexual dysfunction and marital satisfaction among Pakistani males in Karachi
pmc-11725952.creator: Hayat Ali Yousefzai, Siti Irma Fadhilah Ismail, Sana Hussain, Aishah Siddiqah Alimuddin
pmc-11725952.description: BackgroundIn Asian countries, discussing sex-related issues remains a taboo. Sexual dysfunction is not even considered a serious disorder in Pakistan.AimTo explore sexual dysfunction and marital satisfaction within the Pakistani context to develop supportive intervention programs,MethodsThis study entailed a mixed method approach and was carried out in Karachi, Pakistan.

pmc-12530007.title: Physiological Mechanisms and Life History Trade‐Offs in Salmonids Shape In‐Tissue Correlations of an Essential Micronutrient
pmc-12530007.creator: Maciej Jan Ejsmond, Vittoria Todisco, Marc M. Hauber, Kjetil Hindar, Samuel Hylander
pmc-12530007.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The lack of a fitness‐based theory of micronutrient allocation to specific tissues hinders understanding of the ultimate causes of mass juvenile mortality due to thiamine (vitamin B1) deficiency, which is an emerging threat to marine and coastal ecosystems worldwide. We modeled the optimal allocation of thiamine in salmon to somatic and reproductive tissues to investigate correlations between tissue thiamine levels, adult mortality, juvenile recruitment, and excretion rates that change with thiamine concentration.

pmc-12563713.title: miR-218 Regulates the Excitability of VTA Dopamine Neurons and the Mesoaccumbens Pathway in Mice
pmc-12563713.creator: Salvatore Pulcrano, Sebastian L. D’Addario, Mauro Federici, Nicola B. Mercuri, Patrizia Longone, Gian Carlo Bellenchi, Ezia Guatteo
pmc-12563713.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). MiR-218 is a micro-RNA expressed in two isoforms (miR-218-1 and miR-218-2) in the brain and, within the mesencephalic area, it represents a specific regulator of differentiation and functional maturation of the dopamine-releasing neurons (DAn). Deletion of miR-218 isoforms within the midbrain alters the expression of synaptic mRNAs, the neuronal excitability of DAn of the substantia nigra pars compacta (SNpc), and their ability to release dopamine (DA) within the dorsal striatum.

pmc-13188683.title: Corvis ST parameters in eyes with primary angle-closure glaucoma: a retrospective cross-sectional study using propensity score matching
pmc-13188683.creator: Yuta Nakaniida, Kana Tokumo, Shunsuke Nakakura, Ryo Asaoka, Yoshiaki Kiuchi, Hirokazu Sakaguchi
pmc-13188683.description: BackgroundTo evaluate differences in Corvis ST tonometry (CST) parameters between healthy eyes and eyes with primary angle-closure glaucoma (PACG).MethodsWe retrospectively analyzed CST parameters of 24 healthy eyes and 24 eyes with PACG after 1:1 propensity score matching based on age, sex, axial length, intraocular pressure, and central corneal thickness.

pmc-7619557.title: Additionality and Charitable Support for Public Services: Community Fundraiser Perspectives in a Tax-Funded National Health Service
pmc-7619557.creator: Steph Haydon, Ellen Stewart, Francesca Vaghi
pmc-7619557.description: Additionality refers to the idea that charitable contributions to publicly-funded services should enhance, not replace, state provision. Whilst it is often assumed that donors will avoid substitution of public funding when seeking causes to support, longstanding traditions of charitable support for public services (e.g. schools, healthcare facilities) endure.
